note: What each company does, in one sentence, written by an outside agent from the company's own site and other public pages (instinct/about).

accenture.es: Consultora de estrategia, tecnología y operaciones para grandes empresas y administraciones.
accenture.en: Strategy, technology and operations consultancy for large companies and public bodies.

adevinta.es: Grupo de portales de anuncios clasificados online, como Milanuncios e InfoJobs.
adevinta.en: Online classifieds group running marketplaces such as Milanuncios and InfoJobs.

amazon.es: Tienda online de productos de todo tipo, con marketplace para vendedores, nube (AWS) y streaming.

datadog.en: Cloud monitoring of applications, infrastructure and logs for engineering teams.

deloitte.en: Audit, consulting, tax advisory and risk management firm for organizations.

edreams-odigeo.en: Online travel agency for booking flights, hotels and packages, with a discount subscription.

epam-systems.es: Consultora de ingeniería de software y servicios digitales para grandes empresas.
epam-systems.en: Software engineering and digital services consultancy for large enterprises.

glovo.en: On-demand delivery of restaurant food, groceries and urban parcels.

hpe.es: Servidores, almacenamiento y redes para empresas, con servicios de nube híbrida.
hpe.en: Enterprise servers, storage and networking, with hybrid cloud services.

indra.es: Grupo tecnológico de defensa, tráfico aéreo y servicios de TI para empresas y administraciones.
indra.en: Technology group covering defence, air traffic and IT services for companies and governments.

minsait.en: Technology consultancy of the Indra group: digital transformation and IT services for companies.

new-relic.es: Observabilidad de aplicaciones y sistemas en tiempo real para equipos de desarrollo.
